suite: Gallery previews rendered from actual TQ Bootstrap example pages
method: Native viewport PNG screenshots of all 40 served TQ example pages at 1440×900 CSS pixels. Device scale factors 1/3 and 2/3 produce 480×300 and 960×600 files without raster editing or CSS scaling. The original theme script resolves the light colour scheme. Warm actual text glyphs in an unattached canvas and require a 750ms quiet window of native text/font metrics; native animated subtrees keep running and only their moving rectangles are excluded from the font stability signature. Wait for visible images, native Chart/Masonry initialization and settled chart geometry. Pause native carousels and select their first slide only. No CSS, HTML, artwork, photos, fonts, geometry or other application behavior is replaced.
limitations: Previews show the initial 1440×900 desktop viewport in light mode, including native fixed controls. They do not show every section or interactive state.
Original Bootstrap logos, artwork and photographs retain their original colours. Native decorative image content is not a framework colour token.
Remote original dependencies are fetched as their actual bytes and fulfilled at their original browser URLs; original SRI attributes remain enforced. Their exact byte hashes are recorded.

Verification checks recorded PNG bytes/dimensions and frozen source inventory without recapturing or claiming cross-platform pixel identity. Native spinners and other infinite animation continue; previews capture an actual native frame.
sourceInventoryBoundary: The complete before/after asset inventory is retained as historical capture evidence. Ongoing --verify binds all actual capture inputs and all 80 source PNGs. Only the exact gallery index and 80 compiled gallery-thumbnail output paths are excluded from capture-input comparison: none is requested by any captured page, and these outputs are intentionally updated during publication. No recorded hashes are rebound.
